title: Circle Equation: General to Standard Form
body:
A circle has the equation: $$x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 4y - 12 = 0$$

a) Write this equation in standard form $$(x-a)^2 + (y-b)^2 = r^2$$ by completing the square.
b) Hence, state the coordinates of the centre and the radius of the circle.
lesson: Analytical Geometry - Equation of a Circle
